scope: Proposition 2.1 (Tangent box) of the manuscript “Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds” (preprints/Integrability-of-split-tangent-bundles-on-rationally-connected-manifolds-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 052 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cb23bde917710f73), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every holomorphic map g : C → X admits a holomorphic map F : S → X such that F|∆ = g, dF(T(1) ) ⊂ F∗ E1, dF(T(2) ) ⊂ F∗ E2. (2.1) Neither summand is assumed integrable.
